description: This file contains a C# test class 'MemoryStreamCacheMissTests' that extends 'StreamingCacheMissTests' to test memory stream cache miss scenarios within Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes custom configurators for silo and client builders to set up in-memory grain storage and stream filters.

classes.name: MemoryStreamCacheMissTests
classes.description: A test class inheriting from StreamingCacheMissTests, configured for testing cache miss scenarios with memory streams and custom cache eviction settings.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the silo builder to add in-memory grain storage and memory streams with cache eviction options and stream filters.

classes.name: MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the client builder to add in-memory memory streams for testing.

methods.name: MemoryStreamCacheMissTests
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test class with a test output helper.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides base method to configure the test cluster with custom silo and client configurators.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Method in MySiloBuilderConfigurator to set up in-memory storage, cache eviction policies, and stream filters.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Method in MyClientBuilderConfigurator to set up memory streams for the client.
